business_problem: ServiceNow wanted to turn generative AI into a practical operating capability that could reduce support demand, speed agent work, and help developers complete software tasks more efficiently across internal digital technology and customer-facing service workflows.
solution_summary: ServiceNow describes an internal generative AI deployment across self-service, service operations, and software development. The implementation embeds Now Assist capabilities into the company’s existing support and workflow surfaces rather than creating a separate standalone app. On the self-service side, users start in AI search, AI conversations, and the Report an issue flow, where Now Support and Now Assist for IT Service Management (ITSM) help deflect incidents and avoid cases before they reach human agents. In assisted-service workflows, Now Assist for Customer Service Management (CSM) summarizes case context for transferred work, while Now Assist for ITSM generates resolution notes to shorten incident handling. In development, generative AI text-to-code is used inside the Surf shared-services environment to help developers create code and operational flows faster. The article does not name separate storage services, but it clearly ties the AI layer to existing case, incident, support-search, and development workflows on ServiceNow’s platform.
products_used: Now Assist for IT Service Management (ITSM)
Now Assist for Customer Service Management (CSM)

data_flow: Employees and customers begin in self-service entry points such as Now Support search and the Report an issue form, where Now Assist uses existing support content, incidents, and case context to generate answers or deflect requests. If work reaches agents, case notes are summarized and resolution notes are generated inside CSM and ITSM workflows, while developers use text-to-code in the Surf environment.

case notes for transferred or new cases
business_outcome: ServiceNow reports measurable gains in cost savings, case and incident deflection, faster incident closure, and stronger developer productivity from internal generative AI use. The company says self-service reduced dependency on support agents, case summarization improved agent effectiveness, and text-to-code accelerated development work in its shared-services environment.
